name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: First public release: transaction import from SimpleFin, one-time starting balances, pending-transaction reconciliation, automatic internal-transfer detection and linking, custom mapping rules, per-account balance drift display with one-click correction, and scheduled auto-sync.
